title: Who first reported that IPMA moved Lisbon's red rain to 09:00?
summary: IPMA sent the change at 21:23 on Tuesday. By 00:15 we had found no article title or live-blog entry reporting it, but we cannot read SIC Notícias, JN, TSF or Renascença. If one of them (or anyone) reported it earlier, send the address.
closes: An article or live-blog entry with its publication time.
